landing.hero.title: Kickstart Your Financial Management Journey with {platform}
landing.hero.subtitle: Secure and flexible e-learning platform to help you feel more confident to manage your finances.
landing.hero.description: {platform} is brought to you by the Financial Education Network (FEN), an inter-agency platform comprising institutions and agencies committed to improving the financial literacy of Malaysians.
landing.features.title: Why Choose FEN Learning?
landing.features.subtitle: Experience a platform built specifically to empower Malaysians with vital financial skills.
landing.features.item1.title: Learn anytime, anywhere
landing.features.item1.desc: Learn at your own pace with fully flexible online programmes, making financial learning convenient and accessible for everyone.
landing.features.item2.title: Enrol anytime, free of charge
landing.features.item2.desc: There are no fees and no fixed enrolment periods. Begin building essential financial skills, at no cost!
landing.features.item3.title: Receive a certificate
landing.features.item3.desc: Earn a certificate of participation upon completion of the modules that validates your commitment to improving your financial literacy.
landing.features.item4.title: Designed by experts
landing.features.item4.desc: The content is developed by FEN’s subject matter experts ensuring accuracy, quality, and relevance to the target segment.
landing.spotlight.title: FEN PROAKTIF 2.0
landing.spotlight.p1: FEN PROAKTIF 2.0 is an online financial education programme designed to help young Malaysians build the financial management skills they need for the digital age and the first few years of working life.
landing.spotlight.highlight: Achieving financial stability is not just about earning more, it is about being in control of what you have.
landing.spotlight.p2: Achieve financial well-being, not burdens, by understanding your cash flow, protecting what matters, and making smarter decisions for your future.
landing.spotlight.p3: FEN PROAKTIF 2.0 helps you build the confidence you need to manage your finances from today onwards.
landing.learn.title: What you will learn
landing.learn.subtitle: Comperehensive 5 digital course modules about cash flow, debt, risk and investment management.
landing.learn.item1.title: Cash Flow Management
landing.learn.item1.desc: Learn how to keep track of your money so you always know where it is going and stay in control.
landing.learn.item2.title: Debt Management
landing.learn.item2.desc: Understand how to handle debt wisely and avoid money stress before it starts.
landing.learn.item3.title: Building Wealth
landing.learn.item3.desc: Discover ways to grow your money over time, even if you are just starting out.
landing.learn.item4.title: Financial Risk Management
landing.learn.item4.desc: Learn how to protect yourself and your future by managing financial risks confidently.
landing.learn.item5.title: Digital Financial Literacy
landing.learn.item5.desc: Get smart about money in the digital era from online banking to staying safe from scams.
landing.faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
landing.faq.subtitle: Got questions? We've got answers.
landing.faq.item1.q: What do I need to register?
landing.faq.item1.a:
Students: Full name, email, student ID, university/institution, field of study.
Individuals: Full name, email and occupation.
landing.faq.item2.q: What if I forget my password?
landing.faq.item2.a: You can reset it easily using the "Forgot Password" option.
landing.faq.item3.q: Do I need to follow the module order?
landing.faq.item3.a: Yes, you must complete each module before moving to the next.
landing.faq.item4.a: You need at least 60% to earn a certificate. You may repeat the pre survey and post survey if you have not achieved the required score.
landing.faq.item5.q: How do I get my certificate?
landing.faq.item5.a: You can download it from the platform or receive it by email.
landing.faq.item6.q: I need help. Who should I contact?
landing.faq.item6.a: If you need help, please contact learn@fenetwork.my.

terms.section11.body: For questions regarding these Terms & Conditions, contact the platform administrator through the official contact channels listed on {website}.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy - {name}
privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.section1.title: 1. Scope of this Policy
privacy.section1.body1: This Privacy Policy explains how {name} ('we', 'our', 'us') collects, uses, stores, and protects personal data when you use our website at {website} (the 'Platform').
privacy.section1.body2: This policy applies to all learners, visitors, and registered users of the Platform in {country}.
privacy.section2.title: 2. Information We Collect
privacy.section2.body1: When you visit, register, or learn on {name}, we may collect:
privacy.section2.list1: Account information: full name, email address, login credentials
privacy.section2.list2: Profile details: onboarding details that you choose to provide
privacy.section2.list3: Learning records: enrolments, lesson progress, quiz attempts, results, and certificates
privacy.section2.list4: Technical data: browser type, IP address, device and session activity logs
privacy.section2.list5: Support communications: messages submitted through our support or contact channels
privacy.section3.title: 3. How We Use Your Information
privacy.section3.body1: We use personal data for legitimate operational and educational purposes, including to:
privacy.section3.list2: deliver courses and track learner progress
privacy.section3.list4: send service emails such as verification and password reset messages
privacy.section3.list5: monitor platform stability, security, and abuse prevention
privacy.section3.list6: improve course quality and user experience through analytics
privacy.section3.body2: We do not sell your personal data to third parties.
privacy.section4.title: 4. Legal Basis and Consent
privacy.section4.body: By creating an account or using the Platform, you consent to the collection and processing of your information as described in this policy and in accordance with applicable laws in {country}.
privacy.section5.title: 5. Cookies and Similar Technologies
privacy.section5.body: We use essential cookies and session technologies to keep you signed in, protect forms, and maintain secure access to learning features. We do not use third-party advertising cookies.
privacy.section6.title: 6. Data Sharing and Disclosure
privacy.section6.body1: We may share limited data only when necessary with:
privacy.section6.list1: trusted service providers that help us operate the Platform
privacy.section6.list2: authorities where disclosure is required by law or lawful request
privacy.section6.list3: auditors or legal advisors under strict confidentiality obligations
privacy.section6.body2: All such sharing is limited to what is necessary for the stated purpose.
privacy.section7.title: 7. Data Retention
privacy.section7.body: We keep your data only as long as needed for learning operations, compliance, and record-keeping. When no longer required, data is securely deleted or anonymized.
privacy.section8.title: 8. Security Measures
privacy.section8.body: We apply reasonable administrative, technical, and organisational safeguards to protect personal data from unauthorised access, alteration, or loss. No online system can be guaranteed as 100% secure, but we continuously improve our controls.
privacy.section9.title: 9. Your Rights
privacy.section9.body1: Subject to applicable law, you may request to:
privacy.section9.list3: delete your account and related data where applicable
privacy.section10.title: 10. Changes to this Privacy Policy
privacy.section10.body: We may revise this policy from time to time. Updates will be posted on {website} with a revised 'Last updated' date.
privacy.section11.title: 11. Contact
privacy.section11.body: For privacy questions about {name}, please contact the platform administrator through the official communication channels listed on {website}.
about.title: About — {name}
about.heading: About {name}
about.body1: {name} is a free, publicly accessible learning management system built to deliver high-quality educational content without barriers. Our courses cover a wide range of topics, and every learner can access all published content at no cost.
about.body2: We believe that access to knowledge should be universal. Whether you are looking to upskill professionally, explore a new subject, or earn a certificate to demonstrate your learning, this platform is built for you.
about.feature1.title: Free Courses
about.feature1.desc: All published courses are free. No paywalls, no subscriptions.
about.feature2.title: Earn Certificates
about.feature2.desc: Complete a course and automatically receive a PDF certificate.
about.feature3.title: Bilingual Content
about.feature3.desc: Courses available in English and Bahasa Melayu.
about.cta_body: Join thousands of learners and access free courses right now.
